aesthetic: Warm editorial Ethiopian coffee aesthetic. Noma meets Apple meets a high-end Ethiopian coffee brand lookbook. Immersive, rich, earthy but clean and structural. Avoid all cool tones (blue/purple/pink/cyan).

rotating_subtitle.source: self-hosted (Gondens Demo), Google Fonts (Cormorant Garamond Italic)

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-24 for padding to give breathing room. Asymmetric layouts for editorial feel.

navigation.classes: fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 rounded-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF6EF]/70 border border-[#2C1A0E]/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(28,20,16,0.08)]

hero.background: Lightweight CSS/SVG-based flowing strands (organic curves, muted brass/amber strokes on deep espresso background). No WebGL to preserve performance.
hero.layout: Center-aligned or asymmetric text overlay. Typewriter subtitle below the main wordmark.

ethiotopia_orb.style: A glowing/floating CSS-based gradient orb or structural circular element representing 'Ethiotopia'. Central focal point for a mission statement. Use amber/brass gradients.

our_story.layout: Asymmetric two-column. Editorial photography on one side, overlapping text container on the other. Use rich amber and parchment background tones.

menu.layout: Placeholder/coming soon cards with category tabs (Coffee, Food, Pastries). Minimalist bento grid layout.

gallery.style: 3D draggable Dome. Framer Motion + standard CSS 3D transforms to create a draggable circular/dome gallery of images.

reviews.layout: Horizontal scroll cards using Lenis or Framer Motion drag. Cards have 1px borders, subtle soft cream backgrounds.

visit_and_contact.layout: Split section or stacked. Visit info card with Google Maps embed. Contact form uses floating labels (pure CSS or Shadcn customized) wired to a backend endpoint.
visit_and_contact.form_elements: Input fields with border-b only (border-[#2C1A0E]/20), floating label on focus, no heavy card backgrounds.

legal_and_footer.footer: Deep espresso background. 'Did You Know?' note about Ethiopian coffee origin.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these exact URLs for images. DO NOT use placeholder services.

our_story.description: Black ceramic teapot, traditional coffee ceremony element

technical_rules.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx extensions exclusively (no TypeScript / .tsx files).
technical_rules.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='menu-tab-coffee').
